body: An open-source framework for building AI agents and applications that use your documents and data.
plain_description: **Build AI tools that can find and use information in your business documents.** Connect data sources and formats, then create apps that retrieve relevant context and answer questions. Use a broad set of integrations to fit your needs.
technical_description: An open-source Python framework for building agentic applications and LLM apps. It provides data connectors, tools to structure data, and retrieval and query interfaces that return relevant context and knowledge-augmented output. Developers can use its core package with integrations for LLMs, embeddings, and vector stores; the README demonstrates document ingestion and vector indexing with OpenAI or Ollama.
title: LlamaIndex Framework
